race.description: Cargo Transport Systems Mdn F&M Hcp
race.comment: SHEZA BOOM (12) gets the nod in the first despite a plain Warwick Farm result, because she finds something a fair bit easier here and her form prior was up to scratch. Has since trialled a close second on the Inner track here and gets in at featherweight with the 3kg claimer engaged. Can get the job done this time. SEATICFLASH (3) has the cleanest upside profile after a length defeat in third on debut at Pakenham Synthetic where she jumped awkwardly and was steadied early before getting home well late. Has been freshened with 32 days and steps out in new colours. Major player with natural improvement anticipated. MISSION OF JOY (1) also steps out in new colours with Thompson booked from the inside pillar. Her strong SP profile suggests there's some ability there. Keeping safe. WHIP 'N NEIGHNEIGH (15) returned from a spell two-and-a-half weeks ago when she was beaten 3 lengths into seventh over 1000m at this track. Likely improver with top-three prospects.
